hints.title: Positive Element Filtering
hints.text: Negative numbers reduce the total, so only positive distinct elements should be considered.

hints.title: Distinct Set Deduplication
hints.text: Extract unique elements from the array using a set to satisfy the distinct constraint.

hints.title: Top K Selection
hints.text: Sort positive distinct values descending and sum the top min(k, length) values.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: U: number of unique elements in nums
complexity.notes: Deduplication and descending sort of unique positive values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all subset combinations of size k takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set and vector of unique values require O(U) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Filter out non-positive numbers and pick top k distinct elements greedily.
